scope: Public development known-answer corpus; this is a contract-test oracle, not a blind benchmark or real-provider result.
claim_limits: An accepted fixture means only that this synthetic normalized-report contract is internally consistent.
Coverage complete means no gaps or partial signals were reported for this selected range; it is not proof that firmware was fully reconstructed or that runtime behavior is equivalent.
The manifest is public and must not be presented as held-out generalization evidence.
No case invokes REA, Binwalk, Unblob, a decompiler, an emulator, a device, or a hardware-write path.
